units.locator: Article 3.12. Administrative suspension of activities
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 3.12. Administrative suspension of activities
units.label: Art. 3.12

units.locator: Article 3.12. Administrative suspension of activities
units.text: 1. Administrative suspension of activities consists in the temporary cessation of the activities of persons carrying on business without forming a legal entity, legal entities, their branches, representative offices, structural divisions and production sites, and of the operation of machinery, facilities, buildings or structures, the performance of particular types of activities (works), or the provision of services. Administrative suspension of activities is applied where there is a threat to human life or health, an epidemic, an epizootic, infestation (contamination) of regulated articles with quarantine pests, a radiation accident or a man-made disaster, significant harm to the condition or quality of the environment, or where an administrative offence is committed in the field of the circulation of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances and their precursors, plants containing narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances or their precursors, and parts of such plants containing narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances or their precursors; in the field of combating the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime, financing of terrorism and extremist activities, and financing of the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction; in the field of investment activities (in respect of the administrative offences provided for by Article 14.56.1 of this Code); in the field of restrictions on carrying out particular types of activities imposed under federal law in respect of foreign citizens, stateless persons and foreign organisations; in the field of rules for engaging foreign citizens and stateless persons in employment; in the field of administrative order; in the field of public order and public safety; in the field of the production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products; in the field of the production and circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and raw materials for the production of such products; in the field of the circulation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids; in the field of urban development; in the field of transport security; in the field of the protection of property; in the field of the provision of consumer credits (loans), including those under which the borrower's obligations are secured by a mortgage; in the field of the use of cash register equipment; in the field of the sale of admission tickets to UEFA 2020 European Football Championship matches or documents entitling their holders to obtain admission tickets to UEFA 2020 European Football Championship matches; or where an administrative offence is committed that infringes upon health, the sanitary and epidemiological well-being of the population and public morals.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 3.12

units.locator: Article 3.12. Administrative suspension of activities
units.text: Administrative suspension of activities shall be imposed only in the cases provided for by the articles of the Special Part of this Code if a less severe type of administrative penalty cannot ensure that the purpose of the administrative penalty is achieved.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 3.12 · “Administrative suspension of activities shall be imposed only…”

units.locator: Article 3.12. Administrative suspension of activities
units.text: Administrative suspension of activities shall be imposed by a judge. For administrative offences provided for by part 3 (in respect of a gross violation of industrial safety requirements) and part 3.1 of Article 9.1 of this Code, administrative suspension of activities shall be imposed by the officials specified in points 1 and 4 of part 2 of Article 23.31 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 3.12 · “Administrative suspension of activities shall be imposed by a…”

units.locator: Article 3.12. Administrative suspension of activities
units.text: 2. Administrative suspension of activities is established for a period of up to ninety days. The period of administrative suspension of activities shall run from the moment of the actual suspension of the activities of persons carrying on business without forming a legal entity, legal entities, their branches, representative offices, structural divisions and production sites, and of the operation of machinery, facilities, buildings or structures, the performance of particular types of activities (works), or the provision of services.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 3.12

units.locator: Article 3.12. Administrative suspension of activities
units.text: 3. The judge, body or official that imposed an administrative penalty in the form of administrative suspension of activities shall, on the application of the person carrying on business without forming a legal entity or of the legal entity, terminate enforcement of that administrative penalty early if it is established that the circumstances specified in part 1 of this Article that constituted the grounds for imposing that administrative penalty have been eliminated.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 3.12

units.locator: Article 3.12. Administrative suspension of activities
units.text: 4. Administrative suspension of activities shall not be applied where a person is held administratively liable for committing outside the Russian Federation an administrative offence provided for by part 5 of Article 13.15, part 2 of Article 13.48 or Article 20.29 of this Code and that person is outside the Russian Federation when the case concerning the corresponding administrative offence is heard.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 3.12

units.locator: Article 3.13. Compulsory work
units.text: Article 3.13. Compulsory work
units.label: Art. 3.13

units.locator: Article 3.13. Compulsory work
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 3.13. Compulsory work
units.label: Art. 3.13

units.locator: Article 3.13. Compulsory work
units.text: 1. Compulsory work consists in the performance by an individual who has committed an administrative offence of unpaid work for the public benefit during time free from their main employment, service or studies. Compulsory work shall be imposed by a judge.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 3.13

units.locator: Article 3.13. Compulsory work
units.text: 2. Compulsory work is established for a period of twenty to two hundred hours and shall be performed for no more than four hours a day. The maximum daily duration of compulsory work may be increased to eight hours in accordance with the procedure provided for by part 10 of Article 32.13 of this Code.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 3.13

units.locator: Article 3.13. Compulsory work
units.text: 3. Compulsory work shall not be applied to pregnant women; women with children under the age of three and (or) children with disabilities, or women who are adoptive parents, guardians or custodians of such children; men who are single parents with children under the age of three and (or) children with disabilities, or who are the sole adoptive parents, guardians or custodians of such children; persons with disabilities of groups I and II; military personnel; citizens called up for military training; or employees holding special ranks in the Investigative Committee of the Russian Federation, internal affairs bodies, the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, bodies and institutions of the penal enforcement system, compulsory enforcement bodies of the Russian Federation, the State Fire Service and customs authorities. Compulsory work shall not be applied where a person is held administratively liable for committing outside the Russian Federation an administrative offence provided for by Article 20.3.1 of this Code, or an administrative offence consisting in failure to pay, within the time limit provided for by this Code, an administrative fine imposed for an administrative offence provided for by Article 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 17.13 or 19.34, part 3, 4 or 5 of Article 20.1 or Article 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 or 20.33 of this Code, if that person is outside the Russian Federation when the case concerning the corresponding administrative offence is heard.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 3.13

units.locator: Article 3.14. Administrative prohibition on attending the venues of official sporting competitions on the days when they are held
units.text: Article 3.14. Administrative prohibition on attending the venues of official sporting competitions on the days when they are held
units.label: Art. 3.14

units.locator: Article 3.14. Administrative prohibition on attending the venues of official sporting competitions on the days when they are held
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 3.14. Administrative prohibition on attending the venues of official sporting competitions on the days when they are held
units.label: Art. 3.14

units.locator: Article 3.14. Administrative prohibition on attending the venues of official sporting competitions on the days when they are held
units.text: 1. An administrative prohibition on attending the venues of official sporting competitions on the days when they are held consists in a temporary prohibition on a citizen attending those venues on the days of official sporting competitions and is established for a violation of spectator conduct rules during official sporting competitions. An administrative prohibition on attending the venues of official sporting competitions on the days when they are held shall be imposed by a judge.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 3.14

units.locator: Article 3.14. Administrative prohibition on attending the venues of official sporting competitions on the days when they are held
units.text: 2. An administrative prohibition on attending the venues of official sporting competitions on the days when they are held is established for a period of six months to seven years.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 3.14

units.text: Chapter 4. Imposition of administrative penalties

units.locator: Chapter 4. Imposition of administrative penalties
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Chapter 4. IMPOSITION OF ADMINISTRATIVE PENALTIES
units.label: Chapter 4. Imposition of administrative penalties · “Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation.…”

units.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
units.text: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
units.label: Art. 4.1

units.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
units.label: Art. 4.1

units.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
units.text: 1. An administrative penalty for an administrative offence shall be imposed within the limits established by the law providing for liability for that administrative offence, in accordance with this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 4.1

units.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
units.text: 2. When an administrative penalty is imposed on an individual, account shall be taken of the nature of the administrative offence committed, the offender's personal characteristics and financial circumstances, circumstances mitigating administrative liability and circumstances aggravating administrative liability.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 4.1

units.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
units.text: 2.1. When imposing an administrative penalty for administrative offences under legislation on narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances and their precursors on a person recognised as suffering from drug addiction or consuming narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances without a doctor's prescription or new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances, the judge may oblige that person to undergo diagnostic procedures, preventive measures, treatment for drug addiction and (or) medical and (or) social rehabilitation in connection with the consumption of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances without a doctor's prescription or new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances. Compliance with that obligation shall be monitored by authorised federal executive bodies in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2.1 Art. 4.1

units.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
units.text: 2.2. Where exceptional circumstances exist relating to the nature and consequences of the administrative offence committed and the personal characteristics and financial circumstances of the individual being held administratively liable, the judge, body or official hearing administrative offence cases or appeals or protests against rulings and (or) decisions in administrative offence cases may impose an administrative fine below the minimum amount provided for by the relevant article or part of an article of Section II of this Code, if the minimum administrative fine is at least ten thousand roubles for citizens or at least fifty thousand roubles for officials, or below the minimum administrative fine provided for by the relevant article or part of an article of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences, if the minimum administrative fine is at least four thousand roubles for citizens or at least forty thousand roubles for officials.
units.label: Part 2.2 Art. 4.1

units.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
units.text: 2.3. When an administrative penalty is imposed in accordance with part 2.2 of this Article, the administrative fine may not be less than half the minimum administrative fine provided for citizens or officials by the relevant article or part of an article of Section II of this Code or by the relevant article or part of an article of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences.
units.label: Part 2.3 Art. 4.1

units.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
units.text: 3. When an administrative penalty is imposed on a legal entity, account shall be taken of the nature of the administrative offence committed, the legal entity's property and financial position, circumstances mitigating administrative liability and circumstances aggravating administrative liability.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 4.1

units.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
units.text: 3.1. In the cases provided for by part 3 of Article 28.6 of this Code, the administrative penalty shall be imposed in the form of an administrative fine. The fine imposed must be the lowest amount within the sanction of the applicable article or part of an article of Section II of this Code; where the sanction of the applicable article or part of an article of Section II of this Code provides for an administrative penalty in the form of deprivation of the right to operate vehicles or administrative arrest and does not provide for an administrative fine, the administrative penalty shall be imposed in the form of an administrative fine of five thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 4.1

units.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
units.text: 3.2. Where exceptional circumstances exist relating to the nature and consequences of the administrative offence committed and the property and financial position of the legal entity being held administratively liable, the judge, body or official hearing administrative offence cases or appeals or protests against rulings and (or) decisions in administrative offence cases may impose an administrative fine below the minimum amount provided for by the relevant article or part of an article of Section II of this Code or by the relevant article or part of an article of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences, if the minimum administrative fine for legal entities is at least one hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 3.2 Art. 4.1

units.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
units.text: 3.3. When an administrative penalty is imposed in accordance with part 3.2 of this Article, the administrative fine may not be less than half the minimum administrative fine provided for legal entities by the relevant article or part of an article of Section II of this Code or by the relevant article or part of an article of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences.
units.label: Part 3.3 Art. 4.1

units.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
units.text: 3.4. In the cases provided for by part 4 of Article 28.6 of this Code, an administrative penalty in the form of an administrative fine shall be imposed in an amount equal to one third of the minimum administrative fine provided for by parts 2, 4 and 6 of Article 14.5 of this Code.
units.label: Part 3.4 Art. 4.1

units.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
units.text: 3.4-1. When an administrative fine is imposed for an administrative offence detected in the course of state control (supervision) or municipal control, if the administrative fine prescribed by the sanction of the applicable article or part of an article of Section II of this Code or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences has lower and upper limits, and the circumstances provided for by points 5 and 6 of part 1 of Article 4.2 of this Code exist, the administrative fine shall be imposed at the minimum amount established for the corresponding administrative offence, except in the cases provided for by parts 2.2 and 3.2 of this Article and Article 4.1.1 of this Code.
units.label: Part 3.4-1 Art. 4.1

units.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
units.text: 3.4-2. For administrative offences provided for by parts 15 and 18 of Article 13.11 of this Code, an administrative penalty in the form of an administrative fine shall be imposed in an amount equal to one tenth of the minimum administrative fine provided for the corresponding administrative offence, but no less than fifteen million roubles and no more than fifty million roubles, if the person against whom the administrative offence proceedings are being conducted meets all of the following conditions before the ruling imposing the administrative fine is issued:
units.label: Part 3.4-2 Art. 4.1

units.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
units.text: 1) during the three calendar years preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, the operator's annual expenditure on information security measures carried out by organisations holding a licence provided for by point 1 or 5 of part 1 of Article 12 of Federal Law No. 99-FZ of 4 May 2011 'On the Licensing of Certain Types of Activities', or carried out independently provided that the operator holds such a licence, amounted to at least one tenth of a percent of the annual aggregate proceeds from the sale of all goods (works, services) or of the amount of the credit institution's own funds (capital);
units.label: Point 1 Part 3.4-2 Art. 4.1

units.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
units.text: 2) the operator complied with the requirements for the protection of personal data when processing them in personal data information systems, provided that this fact was documented within the twelve months preceding detection of the administrative offence;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3.4-2 Art. 4.1

units.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
units.text: 3) the circumstances aggravating administrative liability provided for by note 5 to Article 13.11 of this Code were absent.
units.label: Point 3 Part 3.4-2 Art. 4.1

units.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
units.text: 3.5. An administrative penalty in the form of a warning shall be imposed, where it is provided for by the relevant article of Section II of this Code or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences, for administrative offences committed for the first time where there is no harm, or threat of harm, to human life and health, fauna and flora, the environment, cultural heritage sites (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation or state security, no threat of natural or man-made emergencies, and no property damage.
units.label: Part 3.5 Art. 4.1

units.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
units.text: 3.6. If, when imposing an administrative penalty for an administrative offence provided for by part 4 or 5 of Article 20.31 of this Code (except in the cases provided for by part 3.9 of this Article), the judge, body or official specified in points 1, 2 and 10 - 12 of part 2 of Article 23.3 and part 2 of Article 23.10 of this Code, taking into account the length of the foreign citizen's or stateless person's residence in the Russian Federation, family situation, attitude to paying Russian taxes, availability of income and housing within the Russian Federation, occupation and profession, law-abiding conduct, application for Russian citizenship and other circumstances, concludes that administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation would constitute an excessive restriction of the right to respect for private life and would be disproportionate to the purposes of the administrative penalty, an administrative penalty shall be imposed in the form of an administrative fine of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or an administrative prohibition on attending the venues of official sporting competitions on the days when they are held for a period of one year to seven years.
units.label: Part 3.6 Art. 4.1

units.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
units.text: 3.7. For an administrative offence provided for by part 4 or 5 of Article 20.31 of this Code, an administrative penalty in the form of administrative arrest for up to fifteen days with administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation may be imposed on a foreign citizen or stateless person if that administrative offence was committed during official international sporting competitions.
units.label: Part 3.7 Art. 4.1

units.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
units.text: 3.8. If, when imposing an administrative penalty in a case where the sanction of the applicable article requires the imposition of administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation (except in the cases provided for by parts 3.6, 3.7 and 3.9 of this Article and for administrative offences provided for by parts 5 - 8 of Article 6.21, parts 3 and 4 of Article 6.21.1, parts 3 and 4 of Article 6.21.2 and part 3 of Article 20.25 of this Code), the judge, body or official specified in points 1, 2 and 10 - 12 of part 2 of Article 23.3 and part 2 of Article 23.10 of this Code, acting within the powers provided for by this Code and taking into account the length of the foreign citizen's or stateless person's residence in the Russian Federation, family situation, attitude to paying taxes provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation, availability of income and housing within the Russian Federation, occupation and profession, law-abiding conduct, application for admission to citizenship of the Russian Federation and other circumstances, concludes that administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation would constitute an excessive restriction of the right to respect for private life and would be disproportionate to the purposes of the administrative penalty, or if there is no state willing to admit a stateless person to its territory, an administrative penalty shall be imposed in the form of an administrative fine of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or compulsory work for a period of one hundred and fifty to two hundred hours.
units.label: Part 3.8 Art. 4.1

units.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
units.text: 3.9. If, when imposing an administrative penalty in a case where the sanction of the applicable article of this Code provides for administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation, it is established that the foreign citizen or stateless person served under contract in the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or military formations of the Russian Federation and participated in combat operations as a member of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or military formations of the Russian Federation, administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation shall not be applied, and an administrative penalty shall be imposed in the form of an administrative fine within the sanction of the applicable article or part of an article of Section II of this Code or compulsory work for a period of one hundred to two hundred hours. When imposing an administrative penalty on persons specified in this part for an administrative offence provided for by part 4 or 5 of Article 20.31 of this Code, an administrative prohibition on attending the venues of official sporting competitions for a period of one year to seven years may also be imposed on those persons.
units.label: Part 3.9 Art. 4.1

units.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
units.text: 4. The imposition of an administrative penalty does not release a person from performing the obligation for non-performance of which the administrative penalty was imposed.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 4.1

units.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
units.text: 5. No one may be held administratively liable twice for the same administrative offence.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 4.1

units.locator: Article 4.1.1. Replacement of an administrative fine with a warning
units.text: Article 4.1.1. Replacement of an administrative fine with a warning
units.label: Art. 4.1.1

units.locator: Article 4.1.1. Replacement of an administrative fine with a warning
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 4.1.1. Replacement of an administrative fine with a warning
units.label: Art. 4.1.1

units.locator: Article 4.1.1. Replacement of an administrative fine with a warning
units.text: 1. For an administrative offence committed for the first time and detected in the course of state control (supervision) or municipal control, where the relevant article of Section II of this Code or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences does not provide for an administrative penalty in the form of a warning, an administrative fine shall be replaced with a warning if the circumstances provided for by part 2 of Article 3.4 of this Code exist, except in the cases provided for by part 2 of this Article.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 4.1.1

units.locator: Article 4.1.1. Replacement of an administrative fine with a warning
units.text: 2. An administrative fine shall not be replaced with a warning where an administrative offence provided for by Articles 13.15, 13.37, 14.31 - 14.33, part 1 of Article 14.39, Articles 14.56, 15.21, 15.27.3, 15.30, 19.3, 19.4.3, 19.5, 19.5.1, 19.6, 19.8 - 19.8.2, 19.23, parts 2 and 3 of Article 19.27, Articles 19.28, 19.29, 19.30, 19.33, 19.34, 20.3 or part 2 of Article 20.28 of this Code has been committed.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 4.1.1

units.locator: Article 4.1.1. Replacement of an administrative fine with a warning
units.text: 3. Where an administrative fine is replaced with a warning, the additional administrative penalty provided for by the relevant article of Section II of this Code or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences shall not be applied.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 4.1.1

units.locator: Article 4.1.2. Special rules for imposing administrative fines on socially oriented non-profit organisations and on legal entities that are small and medium-sized business entities classified as small enterprises, including microenterprises
units.text: Article 4.1.2. Special rules for imposing administrative fines on socially oriented non-profit organisations and on legal entities that are small and medium-sized business entities classified as small enterprises, including microenterprises
units.label: Art. 4.1.2

units.locator: Article 4.1.2. Special rules for imposing administrative fines on socially oriented non-profit organisations and on legal entities that are small and medium-sized business entities classified as small enterprises, including microenterprises
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 4.1.2. Special rules for imposing administrative fines on socially oriented non-profit organisations and on legal entities that are small and medium-sized business entities classified as small enterprises, including microenterprises
units.label: Art. 4.1.2

units.locator: Article 4.1.2. Special rules for imposing administrative fines on socially oriented non-profit organisations and on legal entities that are small and medium-sized business entities classified as small enterprises, including microenterprises
units.text: 1. When an administrative fine is imposed on socially oriented non-profit organisations included, at the time of the administrative offence, in the register of socially oriented non-profit organisations receiving support, or on legal entities that are small and medium-sized business entities classified as small enterprises, including microenterprises, and included, at the time of the administrative offence, in the unified register of small and medium-sized business entities, the administrative fine shall be imposed in the amount prescribed for a person carrying on business without forming a legal entity by the sanction of the relevant article (part of an article) of Section II of this Code, except for administrative offences provided for by parts 6 - 8 of Article 14.3.1, parts 4 - 6 of Article 14.6, part 4 of Article 14.43 and Article 15.12.2 of this Code, or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 4.1.2

units.locator: Article 4.1.2. Special rules for imposing administrative fines on socially oriented non-profit organisations and on legal entities that are small and medium-sized business entities classified as small enterprises, including microenterprises
units.text: 2. If the sanction of an article (part of an article) of Section II of this Code or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences does not provide for an administrative fine for a person carrying on business without forming a legal entity, an administrative fine imposed on socially oriented non-profit organisations included, at the time of the administrative offence, in the register of socially oriented non-profit organisations receiving support, or on legal entities that are small and medium-sized business entities classified as small enterprises, including microenterprises, and included, at the time of the administrative offence, in the unified register of small and medium-sized business entities, shall range from half the minimum amount (minimum value) to half the maximum amount (maximum value) of the administrative fine prescribed for a legal entity by the sanction of the relevant article (part of an article), or shall equal half the administrative fine prescribed for a legal entity by that sanction if it provides for an administrative fine of a fixed amount.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 4.1.2

units.locator: Article 4.1.2. Special rules for imposing administrative fines on socially oriented non-profit organisations and on legal entities that are small and medium-sized business entities classified as small enterprises, including microenterprises
units.text: 3. An administrative fine imposed in accordance with part 2 of this Article may not be less than the minimum administrative fine prescribed for an official by the sanction of the relevant article (part of an article) of Section II of this Code or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 4.1.2

units.locator: Article 4.1.2. Special rules for imposing administrative fines on socially oriented non-profit organisations and on legal entities that are small and medium-sized business entities classified as small enterprises, including microenterprises
units.text: 4. The rules of this Article do not apply when imposing administrative fines for administrative offences for which persons carrying on business without forming a legal entity bear administrative liability as legal entities in accordance with the articles of Section II of this Code.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 4.1.2

units.locator: Article 4.2. Circumstances mitigating administrative liability
units.text: Article 4.2. Circumstances mitigating administrative liability
units.label: Art. 4.2

units.locator: Article 4.2. Circumstances mitigating administrative liability
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 4.2. Circumstances mitigating administrative liability
units.label: Art. 4.2

units.locator: Article 4.2. Circumstances mitigating administrative liability
units.text: 1. The following are recognised as circumstances mitigating administrative liability:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 4.2

units.locator: Article 4.2. Circumstances mitigating administrative liability
units.text: 1) remorse on the part of the person who committed the administrative offence;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 4.2

units.locator: Article 4.2. Circumstances mitigating administrative liability
units.text: 2) voluntary cessation of the unlawful conduct by the person who committed the administrative offence;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 4.2

units.locator: Article 4.2. Circumstances mitigating administrative liability
units.text: 3) voluntary reporting of the administrative offence by the person who committed it to the body authorised to conduct the administrative offence proceedings;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 4.2

units.locator: Article 4.2. Circumstances mitigating administrative liability
units.text: 4) assistance by the person who committed the administrative offence to the body authorised to conduct the administrative offence proceedings in establishing the circumstances to be established in the administrative offence case;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 4.2

units.locator: Article 4.2. Circumstances mitigating administrative liability
units.text: 5) prevention of the harmful consequences of the administrative offence by the person who committed it;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 4.2

units.locator: Article 4.2. Circumstances mitigating administrative liability
units.text: 6) voluntary compensation by the person who committed the administrative offence for the damage caused, or voluntary remediation of the harm caused;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 4.2

units.locator: Article 4.2. Circumstances mitigating administrative liability
units.text: 7) voluntary compliance, before the ruling in the administrative offence case is issued, by the person who committed the administrative offence with a direction to remedy the violation issued to that person by a body exercising state control (supervision) and municipal control;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 4.2

units.locator: Article 4.2. Circumstances mitigating administrative liability
units.text: 8) commission of the administrative offence in a state of intense emotional agitation (affect) or under a combination of difficult personal or family circumstances;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 4.2
